_what: Point the C-Chain coinbase at the DAO treasury Safe. Append this ONE entry to precompileUpgrades in luxfi/universe deploy/lux-mainnet/luxd.yaml (configMaps[0].data['cchain-upgrade.json']), stamp blockTimestamp off the CHAIN clock (+45m), push to GitHub, let the git.hanzo.ai mirror pull, then sync hanzo-cd.
_status: PENDING — not applied. Blocked on mainnet C-Chain being down (v1.36.56 roll, P-Chain height 0).
_why_no_solidity: Fees arrive at the coinbase as a direct AddBalance state credit — no code executes, so the destination does not need to be a contract. Sending 100% to the Safe lets the DAO decide burn vs distribution on-chain, with arbitrary rules, changeable any time. No splitter contract to deploy or maintain.
_why_no_node_change: feeSplitTimestamp (the protocol 50/50) stays OFF deliberately. With IsFeeSplit false, creditTxFee credits the FULL fee to the coinbase — which is exactly the input the DAO wants. Turning the protocol split on would only halve what reaches the Safe and hard-code a ratio that then needs a fork to change.
_governable_after: adminAddresses = the Safe, so the DAO can re-point the reward address later by an on-chain RewardManager transaction — no fork, no redeploy, no config edit.
_consensus_note: dummy.verifyCoinbase rejects a block whose header coinbase disagrees with the configured one, so ALL 5 validators must carry this before blockTimestamp or they fork. Use program/state_upgrade.sh's mount-wait + one-at-a-time roll.
